title: ctenium somalense
intro: Ctenium somalense, commonly known as Somali spider grass, is a species of grass in the family Poaceae. This plant is used in traditional medicine to treat various health conditions, and it is valued for its health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory and antiseptic properties. The therapeutic actions of Ctenium somalense include wound healing, antimicrobial, and antifungal activities, which are attributed to its bioactive constituents, such as flavonoids, alkaloids, and glycosides. The bioactive constituents of this plant are responsible for its medicinal properties, which make it a valuable resource for natural remedies.
